and (d.group is null or d.group = '' or d.group in ('${group}'))
and (d.role is null or d.role = '' or d.role in ('${role}'))
and (d.birthday < #{query.startTime})
and (c.activity_id < #{query.activityId})
and (d.birthday >= #{query.endTime})
and d.avatar_check_status = 'verified'
order by c.id desc limit #{start}, #{size}
